newsitem.title: DENMARK: Unidanmark offers bond database on Internet.
newsitem.headline: Unidanmark offers bond database on Internet.

text.p: Denmark's second biggest banking group, Unidanmark, said on Thursday its Danish bond database was now available on the global Internet system.
"We have put our Danish bond database on Internet to satisfy the growing demand for key information from domestic and international investors," the bank said in a statement.
It said the database included historical information, historical prepayments, economic indicators, general bond information and closing market rates.
